text:
alex: heads-up: canary rollout for release v1.18.0 hit failures during smoke checks. deploybot flagged unhealthy replicas and paused further promos. logs pasted below.

alex: smoke-check logs:
```
[14:02:11] service-smoke: failed assertion: /health -> 500
[14:02:12] trace: downstream connection reset by peer
[14:02:13] retrying probe (2/3) -> timeout
[14:02:15] result: unhealthy
```

priya: looks like a flaky db migration that only happens under higher concurrency. we saw the same stacktrace in staging yesterday but it passed on rerun.

matt: did deploybot auto-roll back the canary?

deploybot: Canary paused for tag `v1.18.0` (ID: canary-4321). Promotion halted at 2/4 pods failed. Auto-rollback attempted but blocked: reserved release with manual gating. (code: CANARY_PAUSE)

alex: we intentionally disabled auto-rollback for this channel to inspect logs before reverting. tradeoff is missing change window if we take too long. change window closes at 14:20 PT.

priya: options: A) force rollback to v1.17.9 (fast, keeps window) B) try hotfix -> push patch to fix migration and re-run canary (risky, may miss window) C) pin back to last-stable and write release note explaining delay.

ops-oncall: what is customer impact right now? error rate spike limited to canary namespace only; prod traffic unaffected so far.

matt: ok then safe bet is to rollback canary to reduce noise. we can still ship a follow-up hotfix targeting the migration flake.

priya: i'm worried about stateful change in DB schema. rollback may leave partial migrations applied. need a rollback plan: ensure migration is idempotent or run DB rollback script.

alex: confirmed migration has an idempotent guard (checks table_exists before ALTER). rollback should be safe. I'll coordinate DB steps.

priya: initiating manual rollback now. steps: 1) mark canary unhealthy in console 2) run `deploybot promote --tag v1.17.9 --scope canary` 3) run db sanity script `scripts/db/check_migrations.sh` 4) notify release coordinator.

alex: running promote command: `deploybot promote --tag v1.17.9 --env canary --reason \"canary smoke failures\"`

deploybot: Promotion queued: v1.17.9 -> canary. Starting prechecks.

deploybot: Prechecks passed. Rolling back canary to v1.17.9 (3 pods rolling restart).

matt: while that's happening, please open a ticket for postmortem and set severity P2. include build IDs, migration scripts, DB host, and logs.

alex: created ticket REL-889 and added short triage notes. linking buildkite build 4321 and logs.

ops-oncall: after rollback, please run read-only probes and a smoke run: `./smoke/run.sh --short` and attach output.

priya: smoke short run passed on v1.17.9 after rollback. probes green at 14:13 PT.

alex: change window safe. releasing note draft: \"Canary paused for v1.18.0 due to intermittent DB migration failure during smoke checks. Rolled canary back to v1.17.9 to preserve change window. Hotfix for migration under investigation; will follow up with postmortem.\"

matt: set status to GO for prod promos for other non-related services. Schedule hotfix board for tomorrow's 10:00 UTC.

deploybot: Canary rollback complete. Tag v1.17.9 active for canary. No automatic deletion of v1.18.0 artifacts.

alex: thanks team. moving this thread to incidents/REL-889 for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
